confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate for July 2026, not checked against live listings or menus. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than July accommodation, which varies widely by district and booking date. Cocktail and wine_glass come from general knowledge and were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 2x and 1.2x). FX came from search-result summaries that cite the RBA exchange-rates table. The rba.gov.au page was not opened directly, so verify the 2026-10-15 value before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against Wroclaw and Gdansk for Polish restaurant and hostel prices, with Brno as a wider Central European check, then adjusted for Krakow's higher July tourist demand for accommodation.
